insight.shared-breath-guardian.label: Shared Breath Guardian
insight.shared-breath-guardian.subject: own_summon
insight.shared-breath-guardian.why: Shared Breath Guardian: Reaction, a spirit joined to you within 30 feet would take damage: the damage is split before any of the spirit's own defenses; you take the smaller half (rounded down), keeping its type and source, through your own Resistance, Immunity and Vulnerability; the spirit takes the rest through its own; your share cannot be transferred again. combat/ext/damage_sharing.py (subject own_summon, timing before_defenses via pre_defense_transfer). The printed PB reduction for a spirit Hosted inside you has no table creature to apply to.
